280599462.description:
Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

283809701.description: This lot features a variety of fossils including coprolite, dinosaur bone fragments, crinoids, gastropods, coral, orthocereas, brachiopods, sea urchins, clams, and stromatolites. It also includes resin-embedded specimens such as an insect and a seahorse, along with some unidentified fossil fragments. Each specimen comes with a descriptive card for identification. The fossils are in generally good condition and are individually labeled for easy reference.

283806501.description: This collection features four natural mineral and stone pieces, including an amethyst crystal cluster with druzy points on matrix, a natural smoky quartz crystal point/cluster, a rough smoky quartz specimen, and a carved green soapstone figure titled "Where the Forest Go" #9508, signed by artist John Craig Loveing Bear. The carved figure depicts an abstract animal form with mottled green and black veining characteristic of soapstone, featuring a polished finish mounted on a rectangular base with visible tool marks. All pieces display natural mineral characteristics and minor surface wear consistent with age and handling. This vintage collection offers a nice variety for the mineral and art collector.
